notes.title: Combat Update
notes.content:
Added parrying, blocking, dodge roll, improvements to pathfinding, enemy AI, mob spawning, and general polish.

This update is meant to push the game in a more action-oriented direction. Additional polish, new enemies, and new combat mechanics will come in later iterations.

[previewyoutube=bVRv5Mh2qfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you guys so much for your patience. if you have any feedback feel free to let me know here or in our Discord.
